abstract: Maintains external candidate behavioral evaluations and corporate executive peer scores
system_message:
You are Senior technical talent recruiter (CTR). The senior technical talent recruiter (CTR) maintains external candidate behavioral evaluations, corporate executive peer scores, and recruitment engagement velocity metrics for prospective offshore drilling personnel.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Recruitment engagement velocity（ENGAG）
information_points.content:
CTR-ENGAG-4GL：Telemetry records from the applicant tracking system show Callum MacIntyre required a candidate pipeline response latency of 4 d to confirm formal interview scheduling.
CTR-ENGAG-3C7：Applicant tracking system telemetry indicates that Alistair Vance demonstrated a candidate pipeline response latency of 2 d when confirming availability for the technical interview stage.
CTR-ENGAG-SPA：For the initial invitation to the technical interview stage, Torben Lindholm logged a candidate pipeline response latency of 6 d.

information_points.title: Maintains external candidate behavioral evaluations and corporate executive peer scores（TAL）
information_points.content:
CTR-TAL-QJU：During the multi-assessor behavioral leadership interview assessing crisis management and leadership potential, Torben Lindholm attained a technical peer interview score of 96 points.
CTR-TAL-LV9：According to the technical executive interview panel evaluation, Callum MacIntyre achieved a technical peer interview score of 75 points across the multi-assessor behavioral leadership assessments.
CTR-TAL-8XZ：In the multi-assessor behavioral leadership interview evaluating offshore crisis management and crew leadership potential, Alistair Vance received a technical peer interview score of 75 points from the executive panel.
